title: 婆婆甩離婚協議：她一通電話，十輛豪車包圍豪宅
description: EP1 離婚協議書｜被當成孤兒羞辱的少奶奶，其實是銀行家族的大小姐。明天繼續。
character_bible: LIN WANQING: a 28-year-old Taiwanese woman, long straight black hair, minimal makeup, calm eyes, cream knit sweater. MRS. ZHOU: 55-year-old woman, short permed hair, deep purple qipao jacket, pearl necklace, sharp expression. ZHOU ZIHAO: 30-year-old man, slicked-back hair, expensive navy suit, arrogant smirk. BUTLER CHEN: 60-year-old man, short gray hair, black suit, white gloves. Cinematic vertical 9:16 video, luxurious mansion living room, dramatic lighting, realistic.

scenes.video_prompt: Opening shot, extreme close-up: Mrs. Zhou throws divorce papers into Lin Wanqing's face, papers flutter. Mrs. Zhou says sharply in Mandarin: "簽了字，淨身出戶，滾！" Camera pushes in on Wanqing's stunned face. Tense, dramatic sound.
scenes.caption: 簽了字，淨身出戶，滾！

scenes.video_prompt: Wanqing calmly picks up the papers from the floor and looks up. She says quietly in Mandarin: "你確定？" Zihao laughs coldly, arms crossed: "你一個孤兒，離了周家什麼都不是。" Medium shots, cold lighting.
scenes.caption: 你一個孤兒，什麼都不是

scenes.video_prompt: Close-up: Wanqing takes out a phone, dials, and says calmly in Mandarin: "陳叔，可以來接我了。" Mrs. Zhou and Zihao exchange amused looks. Slow push-in, ominous music.
scenes.caption: 陳叔，可以來接我了

scenes.video_prompt: Wide shot through the mansion's open doors: ten black luxury cars fill the driveway, Butler Chen in white gloves bows deeply: "大小姐，董事長等您回家。" Mrs. Zhou's teacup falls and shatters. Wanqing turns back with a faint smile: "對了，你們公司的貸款，是我家銀行批的。" Dramatic ending.
scenes.caption: 你們的貸款，是我家銀行批的
